stories.sz: 在以微弱优势击败雅伊尔·博索纳罗四年后，总统卢拉如今在总统决胜轮中迎战其子弗拉维奥。

stories.t: El Salvador president says bodies found in Haiti are not those of hostages
stories.s: Nayib Bukele says bodies delivered to soldiers are "not our men" amid search for Salvadorans abducted last week.
stories.tz: 萨尔瓦多总统称海地发现的尸体并非人质
stories.sz: 纳伊布·布克尔在搜寻上周被绑架的萨尔瓦多人的过程中表示，移交给士兵的尸体“不是我们的人”。

stories.t: More than 1,300 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
stories.s: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.
stories.tz: 法国大规模抗议持续，冲突导致逾1300人被捕
stories.sz: 数十万人在法国参加示威活动，欧洲其他国家也举行了抗议。

stories.t: Gadi Eisenkot campaigns on Moroccan roots in challenge to Netanyahu
stories.s: As Israel prepares to vote, Gadi Eisenkot is leveraging his Moroccan heritage in Likud strongholds such as Sderot. From historical divides to October 7, identity and trauma are redefining the city's political loyalties.
stories.tz: 加迪·埃森科特打出摩根哥血统牌挑战内塔尼亚胡
stories.sz: 随着以色列准备投票，加迪·埃森科特正在斯代罗特等利库德集团的票仓利用其摩根哥血统。从历史分歧到10月7日事件，身份认同与创伤正在重新定义该市的政治忠诚。

stories.t: Prague honors Roma resistance fighters against Hitler
stories.s: More than 1,400 Roma fought against the German Nazi occupation in Czechoslovakia. A new exhibition in Prague showcases the stories of partisans and soldiers whose fates barely received any attention for decades.

stories.t: Saudi Arabia looks to US for an AI edge as Yemen's Houthis up pressure
stories.s: The US is helping Saudi Arabia fight the Houthi group in Yemen with AI-assisted targeting. But AI is not a magic bullet, experts say, and there are technological, political and human rights issues to consider.
stories.tz: 在也门胡塞武装施压之际，沙特阿拉伯寻求美国提供人工智能优势
stories.sz: 美国正利用人工智能辅助定位技术帮助沙特阿拉伯打击也门胡塞武装。但专家表示，人工智能并非万灵药，其中还需要考虑技术、政治和人权问题。

stories.t: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
stories.s: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.
stories.tz: 马斯克称SpaceX曾限制乌克兰的星链连接，目前服务已恢复
stories.sz: 这位科技亿万富翁指责乌克兰将该网络用于军事活动，违反了服务条款。

stories.t: In Bulgaria, record low voter turnout triggers a November 1 presidential run-off in a poll colored by divisions over Ukraine war
stories.s: Low voter turnout has triggered a run-off for the Bulgarian presidency. The vote was colored by strong divisions over Russia's war in Ukraine, and Sofia's relations with the Kremlin.

stories.t: Soldiers guard center of Milan as thousands of protesters march in cities across Europe
stories.s: While protests in France have claimed most international attention, large demonstrations also rocked many European cities Saturday from Milan to Rome to Madrid, Lisbon and Tirana.
stories.tz: 欧洲多国爆发大规模示威游行，军警在米兰市中心戒备
stories.sz: 尽管法国的抗议活动吸引了最多的国际关注，但周六从米兰、罗马到马德里、里斯本和地拉那，欧洲许多城市的街头也爆发了大规模示威游行。

stories.t: Israeli soldiers raze neighbourhood in Hebron, driving families from homes
stories.s: PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows ‘to destroy this place’ in retaliation for militant attack on army checkpoint Israeli troops have levelled a neighbourhood in Hebron, driving out hundreds of families in collective punishment for a militant…
stories.tz: 以军夷平希伯伦居民区，迫使数百家庭背井离乡
stories.sz: 为报复针对军队检查站的武装袭击，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡誓言“彻底摧毁此地”。以色列军队已夷平希伯伦的一个居民区，作为对武装人员袭击的集体惩罚，驱逐了数百个家庭。

stories.t: ‘That’s the way the city works’: how the UAE changed the face of Andy Burnham’s Manchester
stories.s: The story of the emirates’ presence in Manchester winds from the Arab spring to some of the most deprived places in England – with complicated results Emirati-linked firms’ ownership of Manchester land ‘up 39%’ in 10 years When Hosni…
stories.tz: “这就是城市的运作方式”：阿联酋如何改变安迪·伯纳姆的曼彻斯特
stories.sz: 阿联酋在曼彻斯特的存在轨迹横跨阿拉伯之春到英格兰最贫困的地区，并带来了复杂的结果。在过去10年中，阿联酋相关企业在曼彻斯特拥有的土地面积“增加了39%”……

stories.t: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
stories.s: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.
stories.tz: 随着安全管控升级，以色列将在大选日关闭约旦河西岸口岸
stories.sz: 以色列国防军宣布，在周二的大选来临之际，对巴勒斯坦劳工的出行实施限制。
